verdict.rationale: Canva documents REST APIs and publishes an OpenAPI description for generating client SDKs. That spec is a developer building block, not an interactive API reference with runnable examples, and nothing in the evidence describes an in-browser API explorer or try-it console. The probes also found no publicly served OpenAPI file at the standard paths, so the axis applies but there is no evidence it is delivered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Canva provides an OpenAPI description of the REST APIs.
